name: xelta-premiere-mcp

tools.name: pr_status
tools.description: Whether Premiere Pro is running and whether the Xelta CEP extension is installed and alive (its heartbeat age and state: running, wedged, stale or not_running). Never launches Premiere and never sends it a command. Call this first.

tools.name: pr_project_info
tools.description: The open Premiere Pro project: name, file path, unsaved-changes flag (null when Premiere does not report it), every sequence (name, id, width, height, fps, duration_s) and the active sequence. Read-only.

tools.name: pr_catalog
tools.description: List the operations pr_do can run: name, effect (read/write/destructive), description and params as JSON Schema. Never contacts Premiere.

tools.name: pr_do
tools.description: Run one Premiere Pro operation by name with its params. Discover operations and their params with pr_catalog first. Fails with PREMIERE_NOT_RUNNING rather than launching Premiere, and with BRIDGE_NOT_RUNNING when the CEP extension is not loaded.

params.description: The operation's params object (see pr_catalog). Omit when it takes none.

tools.name: pr_preview
tools.description: See one frame of a sequence as an image (JPEG, or PNG from a PNG still preset) at the sequence's full frame size, followed by a JSON summary {width, height, bytes, time_s, frame, timecode, method, sequence}. time_s (default: the player position) is snapped to its frame; outside the sequence it is INVALID_ARGS. Read-only: Premiere's QE layer writes the frame (method qe), else a one-frame Media Encoder export with temporary in/out marks (method ame); the marks, player position and active sequence are put back (previewing a sequence that is not active makes it active for the call, which may open its timeline tab in Premiere), nothing is saved, and the file is deleted after it is read. PREVIEW_FAILED when neither path gives a frame. Use it after a reframe, crop, captions or ducking to check the picture.

time_s.description: Sequence time in seconds, from 0 to the sequence's duration (default: the player position).

sequence.description: Exact sequence name from pr_project_info (default: the active sequence).

tools.name: pr_get_skill
tools.description: Read the bundled Xelta Premiere Pro skills (offline). Without args: the skill index. With name: that skill's SKILL.md. With name + reference: one of its reference files. Load 'xelta-pr-editing-rules' first, before working in Premiere; 'xelta-pr-vertical-reel' for a 9:16 Reel.

name.description: Skill name from the index, e.g. 'xelta-pr-editing-rules'.

reference.description: A reference listed for that skill, e.g. 'references/op-cookbook.md' or 'op-cookbook'.
